Independent post-build metadata QA passed all 27 existing Node CI contract tests; only the release display title and its regression changed, with compiled source, Cargo lock and build configuration unchanged. Publish only these original CI assets, including corresponding source, with the exact digest-bound approved English notes. The launcher download/runtime-choice follow-up is independent of these unchanged backend build inputs. No rebuild or automatic local activation is authorized by this record.
